layoutPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ground-only game terrain planning plate. Input image is a 1024 by 640 neighbor registration board. The flat PINK RECTANGLE (x128..895,y128..639) is the missing district; surrounding painted strips are fixed existing neighbor references. Replace ONLY that pink rectangle with a coherent canal-side pedestrian district. Keep the entire 1024:640 composition and every existing border-strip pixel in place; output the whole board, no crop. The new district is a 768 by 512 logical area. Match all water, paving, grassy bank and low-curb edges where the pink meets the existing north, west and east strips. Continue the turquoise canal and masonry banks naturally from the north-left and western edges through the left side of the new district. Extend the existing western bridge road across/along the canal to accessible land, with no broken or floating bridge ends. The broad cobbled road entering from the top right half curves south into a riverside reading promenade and then east, joining the existing garden road on the RIGHT boundary around 180..245 units below the top of the pink rectangle. Preserve that eastern path port exactly. A southern path exits the bottom edge around the middle-right, for future expansion. Include small low grass-and-soil lots for separate benches, trees and a tiny pavilion; keep the public routes wide, flat, continuous and easy to navigate. Do not fill the entire area uniformly with paving. Painterly elevated orthographic game camera, no horizon; same cream/honey small cobbles, olive grass, granular soil, turquoise canal and stone banks as existing strips. TERRAIN ONLY: no buildings, trees, benches, lamps, boats, furniture, people, text, labels, UI, grid or border. No shadows from absent objects. Remove all pink. Output approximately1536x960 pixels preserving the exact board aspect ratio. This is a planning plate; native detail sources are generated separately.
